typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		EFFDATE as timestamp,
		EFFECTIVEDATE as decimal(38,0),
		TRANS_DT as string,
		TRANS_NBR as decimal(7,0),
		PRFF_CUST_GRP_CD as string,
		EXTNL_TRD_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSourcep021ispprod
OLEDBSourcep021ispprod derive(loadDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> GetCurrentdate
GetCurrentdate derive({Copy of loadDate} = loadDate,
		{Copy of PRFF_CUST_GRP_CD} = PRFF_CUST_GRP_CD,
		{Copy of EFFDATE} = toDate(EFFDATE, "MM/dd/yyyy"),
		{Copy of EFFECTIVEDATE} = EFFECTIVEDATE,
		{Copy of EXTNL_TRD_ID} = EXTNL_TRD_ID,
		{Copy of TRANS_DT} = TRANS_DT,
		{Copy of TRANS_NBR} = TRANS_NBR) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		EXTNL_TRD_ID as string,
		TRANS_NBR as integer,
		EFFDATE as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		TRANS_DT as string,
		EFFECTIVEDATE as integer,
		loadDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		PRFF_CUST_GRP_CD as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		EXTNL_TRD_ID = {Copy of EXTNL_TRD_ID},
		TRANS_NBR = {Copy of TRANS_NBR},
		EFFDATE = {Copy of EFFDATE},
		TRANS_DT = {Copy of TRANS_DT},
		EFFECTIVEDATE = {Copy of EFFECTIVEDATE},
		loadDate = {Copy of loadDate},
		PRFF_CUST_GRP_CD = {Copy of PRFF_CUST_GRP_CD}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
